messages:
ben: Kicking off deploy for release/2026-03-21 v2.4.1 — starting feature flag ramp for `model-routing-v2` to 25% cohorts.

deploy-bot: Deploy D-20260321-1122 started by ben. Initial canaries: us-west-2 5%, eu-west-1 5%. Feature flag `model-routing-v2` set to 5% on canaries.

maria: holding — noticing a small 5xx spike on canary hosts (metric: http_5xx_rate). alert: https://alerts.internal/INC-9876 :thinking_face:

irene: agree with maria. recommend soft pause — cap at 10% total and observe for 10m. if error_rate > 0.5% (5m window) OR p99 latency > 2x baseline => rollback. also request pinning model to `v2.4.1-canary` for canary cohorts.

sam: pinned the model via ffctl: `ffctl pin model-routing-v2 --version v2.4.1-canary --cohorts canary-1,canary-2` -> OK. cohorts now: canary-1 5%, canary-2 5%.

deploy-bot: Feature flag update acknowledged. Current ramp: canary-1 5%, canary-2 5% (total 10%). Soft pause engaged per request.

maria: telemetry snippet — some hosts show latency jump 200ms -> 600ms. attaching trace: https://traces.internal/abcd

irene: thanks. set fallback policy to route retries to old-model and enable KV-cache-bypass for canary to rule out cache invalidations.

ben: plan: watch 10m at 10% then either continue to 25% or rollback. if we roll back, use `scripts/rollback_model.sh v2.3.9` + `deploybot rollback D-20260321-1122`. ops-oncall @sam you own the rollback window 10:30-11:00.

sam: confirmed. rollback playbook staged and monitored. I'll run rollback command if error threshold tripped.

deploy-bot: Reminder: to abort ramp use `deploybot pause D-20260321-1122` or to rollback `deploybot rollback D-20260321-1122`. Current deploy id: D-20260321-1122.

ben: I'll post a short note in #eng-releases when we decide. leaving this thread open for updates in 10m. :thumbsup:

release-notes-bot: Draft saved: /docs/releases/2026-03-21-model-routing.md (internal).

maria: TL;DR — soft pause at 10%, watch 10m. rollback if >0.5% errors OR >2x p99 latency.

ben: good. closing for now; will update thread after observation window.
